name: Interferometric single-shot parity measurement in InAs-Al hybrid devices
problems: a formal 'Matters Arising' challenge was published in Nature (24 June 2026) disputing the validity of the topological gap protocol used to support the paper's central claim
the paper's editorial note states the results do not by themselves constitute evidence for Majorana zero modes, only for the device architecture
source_notes: Microsoft Azure Quantum et al., Nature 638, 651-655 (2025). Underpins the 'Majorana 1' chip announcement. Single-shot interferometric parity measurement in InAs-Al devices, 1% error rate. Subject of an ongoing dispute (see related Legg entry).
